workItem: P8.78 Packaged UI Screenshot Boundary Plan
purpose: Define the future boundary for capturing packaged UI screenshot evidence only after package extraction inventory verification, packaged executable launch smoke, and explicit screenshot authorization exist.

preconditions.description: The existing WindowsUtility package must pass sandboxed extraction inventory verification first.
Packaged executable launch smoke must be explicitly authorized and pass first.
The user/coordinator must explicitly authorize packaged UI screenshot capture.
preconditions.requiredAcceptedResponse: accept sandboxed packaged UI screenshot capture

preconditions.description: Screenshot capture must not require credentials, provider API calls, installer creation, signing, release, or productization authority.

futureAllowedIfAuthorizedLater: use the sandbox extraction directory only
launch packaged executable only under the launch-smoke boundary
capture screenshot evidence under generated/ only
record screenshot metadata and visual evidence links
